title: Surrounded by Studies
content: Here's a photo of Parisian-trained American artistEdwin Lord Weeks(1849-1903) in his studio. He was known for his paintings of the Near East and India.Above him on the walls are many of his plein-air paintings made during his travels. He used these studies for reference as he created new studio paintings.The purpose of plein-air painting for most artists of his era was not to produce a commodity to sell to collectors, but rather to generate a record of the artists observations that they could revisit from the confines of their studios.
